sends_subtitle: Share a secret with a link that ends.
sends_openBody: Paste a Send link. Kemlock opens it here, and no account is needed.
sends_locked: What was typed or received here has been cleared. Unlock Kemlock from the toolbar button, then come back to this tab.
sends_emptyBody: A Send is a text or a file that opens from a link until it is deleted, expires or has been opened as often as you allow. Kemlock Server can’t read it.
sends_needsKemlock: Sends need Kemlock Server sync. You can still open a Send someone gave you.
sends_otherPlace: Sends need Kemlock Server sync, and this browser syncs with {place}. You can still open a Send someone gave you.
sends_away: Your home server is offline since {time}. Sends are kept there.
sends_sessionEnded: Kemlock Server ended this device’s session. Sign in again in the setup tab.
sends_status_unreadable: Can’t be read in this browser
sends_foreignNote: Made in a Bitwarden app. Open, change or share it there.
sends_foreignDeleteBody: This Send, made in a Bitwarden app, and its file stop opening for good. Anyone who has its link loses access.
sends_deleteBody: {name} and its file stop opening for good. Anyone who has its link loses access.
sends_unreadable: This Send’s name and notes don’t open in this browser. It can only be deleted.
sends_waitingNote: The file hasn’t gone up yet, so the link doesn’t open. Delete this Send and make it again.
sends_onHint: Turn it off to stop the link opening, and on again to open it again.
sends_clipboardClears: It clears itself from the clipboard after a while.
sends_linkWarning: Anyone who has the link can open the Send. Kemlock copies it to a clipboard that clears itself.
sends_editFileNote: A file Send’s file and name can’t change. Make a new Send to change them.
sends_fileLimit: A Send takes files up to {limit}.
sends_passwordHint: Optional. The recipient types it to open the Send. Only a proof of it is sent.
sends_hideEmailHint: The recipient isn’t told who sent it. Your server’s rules may not allow this.
sends_making: Sealing the Send and sending it…
sends_deriving: Working out the password’s proof. This can take a moment.
sends_linkMade: {name} can be opened from its link.
sends_linkBody: Anyone who has the link can open the Send. Copy it and paste it into a message. Kemlock never shows the link on the page.
sends_errorTextTooLong: That text is too long for a Send.
sends_errorFileTooBig: That file is too big for a Send.
sends_errorFileTooBigLimit: That file is over {limit}. A Send takes files up to {limit}.
sends_errorDeletion: Choose a deletion date within 30 days.
sends_errorExpiry: The link can’t stop working after the Send is deleted.
sends_errorMaxAccess: The number of opens must be at least 1.
sends_errorMaxAccessFrom: The number of opens must be at least {count}.
sends_errorPolicyPlain: A rule of your server doesn’t allow this.
sends_errorTooLarge: Your server takes files up to {size}.
sends_errorStorage: Your storage on the server doesn’t have room for it.
sends_errorUpload: The file didn’t go up, so the Send was deleted. Try again.
sends_errorNetwork: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
sends_errorServer: The server reported an error. Try again later.
sends_noteTooLong: This text is too long for a note: a note holds 10,000 characters at most.
sends_draftGone: The note’s text is no longer here. Start the Send again from the note.
sends_from: The server says this is from {email}. The sender didn’t sign that.
sends_fileUses: Saving downloads the file, which counts as one open.
sends_tooMany: Too many tries. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
sends_notAvailable: This Send isn’t available. It may have expired, been used up or been deleted.
sends_notAvailableHint: If your connection dropped while it was opening, that open may have been spent.
sends_receivedTooBig: This file is over {limit}, which Kemlock doesn’t download.
sends_bitwarden: This is a Bitwarden Send. Kemlock opens only Kemlock Sends, so open it in a browser tab.
sends_accessRefused: Kemlock needs your permission to ask {host} for this Send. Nothing was requested.
sends_lostReceived: Kemlock no longer holds this Send, because its background stopped while the page was idle. Open the link again.
sends_lostFile: Kemlock no longer holds the file, because its background stopped. Choose the file again and make the Send again.
sends_inputTooLong: That is too long for a Send link. Paste only the link.
